verdict.rationale: Ironclad is legal-ops contract software, so a deadline calendar with reminders is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a compliance or filing-deadline calendar or any reminder or notification feature. The webhooks and Workflows API are developer building blocks that could be used to construct reminders, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one
